app.name: Training & Career Development Platform
app.description: An internal training and career development platform for ministry employees

landing.eyebrow: The Tamkeen career platform for university students
landing.heroBody: Tamkeen stays with you from your first day at university to your first day at work — with a smart career assessment, a training path built for you, and a skills record that grows as you do.
landing.problemTitle: Talent is here. The bridge to opportunity is what was missing.
landing.problemBody: Students graduate with a strong academic record but no clear path from major to first job. Tamkeen builds that bridge: assessment, training and matched opportunities, all in one place.
landing.problem1Point1: No clear path from a chosen major to a real first job.
landing.problem1Point2: The skills employers need are not the skills in the syllabus.
landing.problem1Point3: Hard to know which certifications and activities actually matter.
landing.problem2Point1: Job listings live on a dozen disconnected sites.
landing.problem2Point2: Co-op placements depend on luck and personal contacts.
landing.problem2Point3: No single document captures everything you have done.
landing.problem3Point1: Hard to tell which students need help before they graduate.
landing.problem3Point2: No visibility into what employers actually want this semester.
landing.problem3Point3: One-to-one career guidance does not scale to thousands of advisees.
landing.problem4Point1: Reaching university graduates means going through scattered channels.
landing.problem4Point2: No way to filter candidates by evidenced skill — only by grade average.
landing.problem4Point3: Co-op programmes need an organised pipeline, not ad-hoc emails.
landing.solution1: A psychometric assessment that maps majors to career paths.
landing.solution2: A personalised training roadmap built by Guide, the AI advisor.
landing.solution3: A skills record that updates itself as you complete each milestone.
landing.solution4: AI-matched opportunities from Aramco, SDAIA, NEOM, SABIC, and more.
landing.solution5: A dashboard for the university, tracking readiness across every cohort.
landing.featuresTitle: Four steps from your first day to your first job
landing.featuresBody: Tamkeen is the bridge between your university degree and the Saudi job market — guided end-to-end by Guide, your AI career advisor.
landing.feature1Body: Complete a psychometric assessment to find the career path that matches your interests, your skills and your personality.
landing.feature2Body: Get a tailored roadmap of the courses, certifications and activities that build the skills the job market actually needs.
landing.feature3Body: Your achievements are logged automatically, so you graduate with two documents: your academic transcript and your skills record.
landing.feature4Body: Browse the jobs, co-op placements and certifications matched to your profile, and apply directly through Tamkeen.
landing.journeysTitle: Every career stage has its own path
landing.journeysBody: In Tamkeen each group has a clear journey: it begins with registering and building a profile, then moves through guidance and development to the right opportunities.
landing.ecosystemBody: From students and teaching staff to employers and training providers, each side gets what it needs from a single experience.

landing.ctaTitle: See Tamkeen running on real university data
landing.ctaBody: One demo account, one tour. Five minutes from signing in to seeing the whole story.

landing.footerAudience: A platform for Saudi university students

R.name: Realistic
R.summary: You lean towards hands-on, practical work, and prefer tasks whose results show up in the real world.

I.name: Investigative
I.summary: You lean towards analysis and enquiry, and enjoy understanding why a problem happens before solving it.

A.name: Artistic
A.summary: You lean towards creating and expressing, and prefer work that leaves room for a style of your own.

S.name: Social
S.summary: You lean towards working with people and helping them, and find your reward in teaching and service.

E.name: Enterprising
E.summary: You lean towards leading and initiating, and enjoy persuading others and carrying responsibility.

C.name: Conventional
C.summary: You lean towards order and precision, and prefer work that follows clear, well-defined procedures.
